messages.subject: 2 Legends, but I only need 1!
parts:
Hello,

I'm new at ggplot2 and I was hoping someone might help me with a
problem. I'm trying to graph 2 lines based on a dichotomous split
('EF_Split'). I'm looking for different line types, but I want both
lines to be black.

I can achieve this with the below syntax, however I get 2 legends: one
for color, one for line type. When I attempt to use scale_x_discrete
to label the legend twice (once for linetype, once for colour), I get
non-black lines.

Please help!


EFSplit <- factor(EF4_Split, labels = c("Low EF", "High EF"))

EFSplit.log.Plot <- ggplot(Graphs, aes(y=logmean2758, x=I(SmplNumb+1),
colour = EFSplit, linetype=EFSplit))+ stat_smooth(method=loess,
size=1.25)

EFSplit.log.Plot + xlab("Sample") + ylab("Log-Transformed Cortisol") +
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-2.5,-1.25)) + scale_y_continuous
(breaks=c(-2.25,-2,-1.75,-1.5)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(1,2,3))
+ theme_bw() + scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "black")) +
scale_linetype_manual(values = c(1,2)) + scale_linetype_discrete("EF
Ability") #+ scale_colour_discrete("EF Ability")

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: 2 Legends, but I only need 1!
parts:
If you want the lines to be black, just leave off colour = EFSplit

Hadley
